variant.author: pupwife
variant.changelog:
- Added filtering options to focus-targeting. By default, /sft will now only target players and combat NPCs, but this can be customised.
- Added a credits page with GitHub attributions. Future contributors will be added here as needed.
- Added tabs to house these new pages without cluttering the UI.
- The command description now only shows up on the About page.
- Fixed the window size so that it doesn't keep resizing all over the place when changing tabs or languages.
